neet_phy_u16_t03_2.working: Light emerges only where incidence is below the critical angle, so r = h tan C = h/sqrt(n^2-1) = 8/sqrt(25/9-1) = 8/(4/3) = 6 cm.

neet_phy_u16_t03_3.working: TIR at 45° needs C < 45°, so sin45° > 1/n, giving n > √2 ≈ 1.414. Only 1.50 qualifies.

neet_phy_u16_t03_4.working: Diamond: small critical angle 24.4° (III). Optical fibre: core denser than cladding (I). Mirage: TIR at hot rarer air near the ground (IV). Periscope prism: right-angled isosceles prism with n > √2 (II).

neet_phy_u16_t03_5.working: A true. B true, since violet has larger n and so smaller C. C false, since TIR transmits no refracted light. D false, since glass-water has a smaller relative n and so a larger C. E true.
